reason: The proof answers the cited Question 17.18 under its stated hypotheses. For paired child colors with marginal 1/2 and disagreement d, the exact disagreement probabilities are D2=d-d^2/2 for AND of two and D3=3d/4-3d^2/4+d^3/4 for OR of three. Weighting by 3/5 and 2/5 gives D(d)=9d/10-3d^2/5+d^3/10 <= 9d/10 on [0,1]. Hence E[q_n(1-q_n)]=d_n/2 tends to zero; martingale convergence gives a measurable {0,1} color with mass 1/2, satisfying the symmetric AND/OR recursion at every vertex almost surely. Every vertex has a child of its own color. Choosing uniformly among such children is equivariant and consistent; conditional on the child-color vector, eligible subtrees have law GW conditioned on that color, so mixing over the root color gives GW again. Thus GW is stationary, equivalent to itself, while the invariant root-color event has probability 1/2. The source definition permits nonnegative weights; strict positivity is an extra hypothesis in Proposition 17.17, so zero weights are allowed for Question 17.18. The full-measure coloring can be extended to a total flow rule by using a hereditary Borel good set and, off it, a default flow choosing uniformly among infinite child subtrees. Keep the mathematical counterexample; this does not verify novelty or current literature status.
